capabilities: generate structured notes from raw text or YouTube transcripts
suggest tags and wikilinks for the active note
run free-form instructions (translate, summarize, rewrite) on notes
search the vault semantically and detect similar notes
clean broken wikilinks and manage the active note (rename, move, duplicate, delete)
extras: Desktop only (Windows, macOS, Linux), not available on mobile; requires Obsidian 1.4.0+. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Privacy section states note content is sent to Anthropic only when a command is triggered, with no third-party servers.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistance for structuring raw text into notes, proposing tags and links, or turning YouTube transcripts into notes.

relations.evidence: Using the Anthropic Claude API (Bring Your Own Key)

summary: AI note assistant that generates structured notes, suggests tags and wikilinks, runs instructions on notes, and summarizes YouTube videos via the Anthropic Claude API.
